constraints.translation: If Recipient does not receive any license/IP rights, then it is not the case that Recipient receives a license/IP right.
constraints.evidence: 3. No Other Rights: “does not receive any license…”
constraints.reasoning: Mutual exclusivity of receiving vs not receiving the license/right.

constraints.translation: Recipient may independently develop/acquire technology for its own products/services/processes.
constraints.evidence: 3. No Other Rights: “may independently develop and acquire…”

constraints.translation: If Recipient does independently develop/acquire, then it is true that Recipient may do so.
constraints.evidence: 3. No Other Rights: “may independently develop and acquire…”

constraints.translation: Access to Discloser’s CI does not prohibit developing/acquiring similar products without obligation to Discloser.
constraints.evidence: 3. No Other Rights: “does not prohibit… without obligation…”

constraints.translation: Recipient is free to use residuals of CI for any purpose.
constraints.evidence: 3. No Other Rights: “is free to use the residuals…”

constraints.translation: Either party may terminate upon 10 days’ written notice.
constraints.evidence: 4. Termination: “Either party may terminate… upon 10 days’ written notice.”

constraints.translation: If a party terminates upon 10 days’ written notice, then it is true the party may terminate upon 10 days’ written notice.
constraints.evidence: 4. Termination: “may terminate… upon 10 days’ written notice.”

constraints.translation: CI remains subject to NDA terms even after termination.
constraints.evidence: 4. Termination: “will remain subject to the terms of this NDA.”

constraints.translation: All CI is provided AS IS.
constraints.evidence: 5. General: “All CI is provided ‘AS IS’”

constraints.translation: All warranties are disclaimed.
constraints.evidence: 5. General: “all warranties… are disclaimed.”

constraints.translation: Transfers attempted without prior written consent are null and void.
constraints.evidence: 5. General: “Any attempt to transfer… without… consent… will be null and void.”

constraints.translation: The NDA may only be modified by mutual written agreement signed by authorized representatives.
constraints.evidence: 5. General: “may only be modified by mutual written agreement signed…”
constraints.reasoning: The phrase 'may only' sets an exclusive condition.

constraints.translation: If the NDA is modified by mutual written agreement signed by authorized representatives, then it is true that the NDA may only be modified that way.
constraints.evidence: 5. General: “may only be modified…”
constraints.reasoning: Modal-drop linkage (actual modification in that form is consistent with and implies the permissive 'may only' statement).

constraints.translation: This NDA is the complete agreement as to the subject matter.
constraints.evidence: 5. General: “contains the complete agreement…”

constraints.translation: This NDA supersedes other communications/agreements about the subject matter.
constraints.evidence: 5. General: “replaces and supersedes any other communications, or agreements…”

constraints.translation: California law governs and construes the NDA.
constraints.evidence: 5. General: “governed by… laws… State of California.”

constraints.translation: If governed by California law, then it is not governed by New York law.
constraints.evidence: 5. General: “State of California”
constraints.reasoning: Governing-law choice is ordinarily exclusive among different states.

constraints.translation: If governed by California law, then it is not governed by Delaware law.
constraints.evidence: 5. General: “State of California”
constraints.reasoning: Governing-law choice is ordinarily exclusive among different states.

constraints.translation: The parties will comply with export laws/regulations for use/disclosure of CI.
constraints.evidence: 5. General: “will comply with all applicable export laws and regulations”

constraints.translation: If the parties comply, then it is true that the parties will comply.
constraints.evidence: 5. General: “will comply”
constraints.reasoning: Modal-drop linkage between plain and modal versions.

constraints.translation: The NDA may be executed in counterparts.
constraints.evidence: 5. General: “may be executed in counterparts”

constraints.translation: If executed in counterparts, then it is true it may be executed in counterparts.
constraints.evidence: 5. General: “may be executed in counterparts”

constraints.translation: The NDA may be signed electronically.
constraints.evidence: 5. General: “may be signed electronically”

constraints.translation: If signed electronically, then it is true it may be signed electronically.
constraints.evidence: 5. General: “may be signed electronically”

constraints.translation: The NDA may be signed with handwritten signatures.
constraints.evidence: 5. General: “or with handwritten signatures”

constraints.translation: If signed with handwritten signatures, then it is true it may be signed with handwritten signatures.
constraints.evidence: 5. General: “may be signed… with handwritten signatures”

constraints.translation: If a dispute arises, the English version controls.
constraints.evidence: 5. General: “English language version… will be the version used if any dispute arises.”

constraints.translation: If the English version is used in a dispute, then it is not the case that a non-English version is used in a dispute.
constraints.evidence: 5. General: “English language version… will be the version used”
constraints.reasoning: Ordinary mutual exclusivity: one controlling version in a dispute.

constraints.translation: The parties listed are Adobe Inc. and Acme Corporation Inc.
constraints.evidence: Signature block: “Adobe Inc. Acme Corporation Inc.”
constraints.reasoning: Explicit naming in the execution block.
